payload.title: Public release readiness and launch preparation
payload.description: Verify the DataParade-io repository and existing MIT licensing; audit and fix concrete quality/security gaps with synthetic specifications; make installation and CLI/library docs accurate; package and publish via the existing crates.io release setup only; record tested install receipts. Prepare factual publicity for later review and Papyrus-powered sites, with logo design owned by Ryan. Coordinate Git hook installation with the LeftBlock owner. No new credentials, publisher grants, licensing changes, promotional publication, or monitoring/Cyclotron work.
